description: This file defines the Zend_Http_Cookie class, which models an HTTP cookie including its parameters, validation, and matching logic within the Zend Framework.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Cookie
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP cookie with properties such as name, value, domain, path, expiry, and security. It includes methods to check expiration, validity for a given URI, and to parse cookies from strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Zend_Http_Cookie; initializes cookie properties and performs validation on name and domain.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns the domain associated with the cookie.

methods.name: getExpiryTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry timestamp or null if not set.

methods.name: isSecure
methods.description: Indicates whether the cookie is secure.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has expired based on the current time.

methods.name: isSessionCookie
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is a session cookie (no expiry time).

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines if the cookie should be sent for a particular URI, considering security, expiry, session status, domain, and path.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the cookie as a string suitable for an HTTP header.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a new Zend_Http_Cookie from a cookie string, optionally using a reference URI for default domain and path.

methods.name: matchCookieDomain
methods.description: Static method to check if a cookie's domain matches a given host.

methods.name: matchCookiePath
methods.description: Static method to check if a cookie's path matches a URL path.
